import json, sys, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("entry", "/app/submission/entry.py")

lo, hi = 0, len(evs)
# find max prefix that validates
def val(n):

        m._validate(d); return True
    except m.Invalid: return False

    n *= 2
